abstract: Audits ecological disturbance permitting and intertidal habitat compliance
system_message:
You are the Environmental and acoustic compliance lead (ENV), responsible for auditing ecological disturbance permitting, marine licensing consent, and intertidal habitat buffering across candidate marshalling port facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Avian protection buffering（BIRD）
information_points.content:
ENV-BIRD-9EN：Under the ecological monitoring charter, the Tees Integrated Marine Terminal maintains an intertidal bird feeding buffer zone width of 350 m between staging activity and the adjacent protected mudflat conservation zone.
ENV-BIRD-85O：Under the ecological monitoring charter, the Tyne Renewable Energy Park maintains an intertidal bird feeding buffer zone width of 250 m between staging activity and the adjacent protected mudflat conservation zone.
ENV-BIRD-TPO：Under the ecological monitoring charter, the Humber Deepwater Outer Basin maintains an intertidal bird feeding buffer zone width of 150 m between staging activity and the adjacent protected mudflat conservation zone.

information_points.title: Audits ecological disturbance permitting and intertidal habitat compliance（ECOL）
information_points.content:
ENV-ECOL-RPZ：For the Tees Integrated Marine Terminal, statutory marine licensing inspection confirms that environmental disturbance permit compliance is maintained across the port operational boundary and adjacent protected marine zones.
ENV-ECOL-X2L：For the Humber Deepwater Outer Basin, statutory marine licensing inspection confirms that environmental disturbance permit compliance is in full effect across the port operational boundary and adjacent protected marine zones.
ENV-ECOL-YEW：For the Tyne Renewable Energy Park, marine licensing records indicate that environmental disturbance permit compliance is not maintained across the port operational boundary and adjacent protected marine zones.
